bindings.expected: Every repository command contract keeps only receipt-backed tasks ending with outcome.verified and archive.run
bindings.justification: The assertion requires zero violations across every repository command contract: schema 3.0, <=10 contiguous required tasks ending with outcome.verified/archive.run, receipt-backed families or typed execution/review evidence only, no documentary observable-output demand, a livespec stop condition argv with a matching display string, and a contract checklist equal to the active inventory.

bindings.expected: The goal runs the stop condition itself: non-zero exit, launch failure, timeout and a silent check with only declared text are rejected; exit 0 with output or a silent check with an existing artifact is accepted
bindings.justification: The single assertion compares the proof status of six simulated stop-condition outcomes (the runner subprocess is replaced, the goal still executes it): declared exit 0 never overrides a non-zero exit, OSError/TimeoutExpired are rejected, exit 0 with output and silent exit 0 with an existing artifact are accepted, silent exit 0 with declared output text is rejected.

bindings.expected: Goal requirement is required only for autonomous long runs
bindings.justification: The assertion compares goal_requirement for the full command/flag matrix (ship, feature --auto, init --auto, implement without --step/--dry-run versus interactive commands) with the expected required/optional values.

bindings.expected: No skill blocks on native goal tools or an active goal; only autonomous-capable skills keep a goal step
bindings.justification: The assertion requires zero violations: no ABSOLU, /goal clear, unavailable-/goal stop or active-goal stop text in any skill, STEP 0 with create_goal, /goal and a warning fallback in goal skills, and no goal render step elsewhere.

bindings.expected: A drifted contract is recompiled in place and keeps still-valid evidence
bindings.justification: After adding a before-test hook (input drift), the single assertion requires: recompiled report from the old hash, qe.analysis carried, contract and state rewritten in place under the new hash with the hooks.before task, qe.analysis and outcome.verified complete, recompiled_from recorded in the state, and a re-render of the drifted goal at new paths adopting the carried progress. The unnumbered slug resolution is asserted earlier in the same test and the failed-recompile block is covered by a dedicated test.

bindings.expected: The contract has no per-task convention proof names or conventions payload, conventions.gate is the only receipt task, and a non-PASS receipt is rejected
bindings.justification: The single assertion requires an empty problem list: none of required_conventions, convention_domains_recorded, convention_sources_read, conventions_applied_to_output appears in the canonical contract, no conventions payload, conventions.gate is the only task requiring conventions_receipt_path, and proving it with a FAIL receipt reports conventions_receipt_verdict_pass missing.

bindings.expected: The third rejection of a task returns BLOCKED
bindings.justification: Three invalid qe.analysis proofs are submitted and the assertion requires the third result status to be BLOCKED after two REJECTED_NEEDS_ACTION results.

bindings.expected: A completed autonomous init writes its completed recap despite an elapsed deadline
bindings.justification: _generate runs with an already expired deadline and stubbed bounded steps; the assertion requires the final write to be the completed bootstrap recap, so no deadline error was raised.

bindings.expected: The runtime goal prompt is short, neutral and allows reusing an active goal
bindings.justification: The single assertion requires an empty problem list: no MUST/ABSOLU/'/goal clear'/'BLOCKED and stop' anywhere in the anti-drift block, a goal section of at most 15 lines with the active-goal reuse rule, every STEP 0 at most 20 lines, README/expectations/both spec-system copies naming the outcome contract, the obsolete goal modules and child-goal code deleted, and goal module lines below the 5813-line main baseline.
